title: Dead card CSS deleted: portfolio-dossier block, project groups, link cards, flow steps, composite shell and header, hidden VN source cards; each class proven absent from the built site first
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, section 'Cards: inventory and cuts (map revision 3)', class 'dead'. These card rules have no element on the built site: no content file, component or generator emits the class. Deleting them is pure subtraction, so this cut is second; it has no visual outcome if the proof holds. Line numbers are from 410485e and shift after home-flat; re-read by selector.

Proof before deletion, per class: grep -rn <class> GameCult site/quartz scripts (excluding custom.scss) is empty, and after a local build (.\scripts\quartz\quartz.ps1 build) grep -rl <class> public is empty. A class with a hit stays and is reported as a deviation. Expected dead at 410485e: gamecult-project-groups, gamecult-project-group, gamecult-link-grid, gamecult-link-card, gamecult-flow, gamecult-flow-step, gamecult-composite-page, gamecult-composite-jump, gamecult-composite-sections, gamecult-composite-section, gamecult-composite-divider, gamecult-composite-shell, gamecult-composite-media, gamecult-composite-copy, gamecult-composite-header, gamecult-composite-body, portfolio-dossier-page and every portfolio-dossier-* and portfolio-* class, gamecult-doc-tree-* (the generator writes repo-doc-tree.js/json under static, not markup).

gamecult-composite-overview is live: GameCult/tour.md 62 sets it in cssclasses, so the rule at 1937-1940 (> h2, > ul hidden) stays. The composite branch of site/quartz/components/GameCultCompositeContent.tsx (compositeSections) is reached by no content file; it is not cut here and is listed as a follow-up for the Self, since removing a component is a product decision, not a card.

The VN source cards on /tour and /Pitch (GameCult/tour.md 76-140, Pitch.md): section.gamecult-vn-source is clipped to 1px by custom.scss 1607-1617 (inside the tour/Pitch block) and again, identically, by 1620-1631 outside it. The Sai player clones each [data-sai-dom-source] node into its overlay (.sai-dom-card). Hands checks the live DOM on /tour after the player has shown a DOM card: if a .sai-dom-card descendant carries class gamecult-vn-source-card, the rule at 1808-1814 is a card inside Sai's floating card and is flattened (border, border-radius, background deleted; padding stays; h2/p/img rules stay); if not, 1801-1925 is dead on screen and is deleted whole. Either way the duplicate clip rule 1620-1631 is deleted.
Rulings: operator-no-cards-except-floats. Pills untouched. Masthead untouched. The engine is not edited.
